facility.name: Aim High Preparatory LLC
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The playground did not have the required 6 inches of loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: The following below were incomplete: 2 students missing admission's date, 1 student missing emergency contact address, and 3 students were missing special needs statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of four children files reviewed did not have an immunization record available for licensing to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operation franchise tax is inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: There was not a current fire inspection available for licensing to review. The last inspection was conducted on 7/30/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Observed brown ceiling tiles and missing floor tiles in the school age room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The menu showing the meals served on 07/03/2024 was not posted nor available for review.  NOTE:  Corrected during the inspection when the director hand wrote the menu which was posted on the door for all to view.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Based off information gathered during investigation inspection it was discovered 2 caregivers hired on 1/11/2024 and 6/13/2023 had not completed orientation training and falsified documents of the trainings were observed in files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving: Based upon the information obtained, sufficient evidence was available to support children are not served seconds upon their request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving (26 TAC §746.3301(e))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the investigation inspection the director and the permit owner got into an argument and the use of profane language while children were in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Based off information obtained during investigation inspection it was determined that the high diploma observed in a caregiver folder was falsified document.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Based off information obtained during the inspection first aid training provided to licensing listed a caregiver name but after scanning the QR Code it listed the director's name. Caregiver was observed caring for children alone on 5/23/2024. The hire date for caregiver May 15,2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Based off information obtained during the investigation inspection it was determined 2 caregivers preservice training documents observed in their files were falsified documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of the six caregivers first aid license observed to be expired dated 4/18/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One of the six caregivers cpr/first aid license observed to be expired dated 4/18/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Based on information gathered the operation admitted during the inspection of failure to notify parent of a child being left outside unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information gathered during inspection a child was left outside on the playground unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on information gathered at inspection operation failed to create an incident report of a child left outside on playground unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on information gathered at inspection a child was left unsupervised outside on the playground on 4/25/2024. The operation failed to report to licensing with the reuired 48hr timeframe. Report was recieved 5/7/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The area in front of the slides on both playgrounds ground and dirt was exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director provided a certificate of completion for 50 clock training hours without description of subjects covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: One caregiver was observed on two different occasions leaving children unattended. The first incident Licensing Inspector was observed at the front desk when the Toddler caregiver was observed in the hallway. The second incident occurred at 7:56AM when the Toddler caregiver left 15 toddlers with Licensing Inspector in a classroom while retrieving breakfast waffles from the kitchen area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Two out of three toilets in the school-age classroom was not in working condition. One out of three toilets was covered with a plastic bag.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Upon arrival, one infant 3 months of age was observed in a car seat sleeping. The infant was observed sleeping for approximately 15 minutes in the car seat. The infant was restrained in the device for over 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed in the infant classroom with 6 infants, 2-15 months of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: One individual who is listed as a staff/employee was left in charge to retrieve children from the transportation center. The individual is 16 years of age, and was left in charge while the Director(s) were providing transportation services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: The caregiver in the toddler classroom was not aware of the ages of the children in which they were responsible for. The caregiver could not specify the youngest, or the oldest child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: The driver evacuated the vehicle without following the proper procedures to ensure all children were unloaded, and/or accounted for. The child was left on the transportation vehicle unsupervised for approximately 12 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: A transportation driver did not check the transportation vehicle prior to entering the daycare facility. A child was left unattended on the transportation vehicle. The driver was not aware that a child had been left unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Communication Between Center and Vehicle - Route, Times Known: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation staff were not able to provide documentation in order to verify the routine route, the departure time, and/or arrival time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Communication Between Center and Vehicle - Route, Times Known (26 TAC §746.5621(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: Based on the information obtained, the transportation driver did not have a list of children who was being transported. The transportation driver was not aware of the names of the children in their care, or the name of the child whom was left on the transportation vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: A child 5 years of age was left unattended for approximately 12 minutes on a transportation vehicle. Child neglect was portrayed by operation staff by not conducting a name to face check, and ensuring all children evacuated the vehicle safely.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation released two children to a relative without checking identification. The incident occurred on 1/24/2022. Once the older sibling was released, the operation then requested to check identification. Reportedly, the operation did not verify the identification card/photo ID with the children admission forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4103(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Provided By: During the annual monitor inspection records were not available for review, in which the Director then  provided to Licensing at a later date.   While reviewing records, it was observed that the trainings provided were conducted by the Director, in which the operation had received an administrative penalty on 07/15/2021. The operation also received an administrative penalty on 11/19/2021. The operation Director provided 20-24 hours of training to their staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Provided By (26 TAC §746.1317(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver observed in the school-age classroom had an inactive background check.     Most recent employment validation took place in December of 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The emergency practice form was not avaible for review during the monitor inspection, and/or the Health and Safety Audit.  Inspector was not able to observe emergency drill, fire extinguisher, or smoke detectors documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The most recent fire inspection was dated 07/26/2019. The inspection would be invalid as of 12/30/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: One playground area observed did not have an adequate amount of mulch for surfacing. The mulch had dissolved. The assistant stated that the area has not been utilized currently.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Staff records were not avaible for review during the annual inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))
